coaching.headline: Eight fights won and six of them cashed into a prize inside 90 seconds — GRIM.exe's 17/1 became a 22-9 majors lead and a 27-minute close.
coaching.team: This is the blueprint for converting: we won eight of eleven clustered fights, lost just one, and six of the eight wins bought a major within 90 seconds — the 13.7 fight at their outer tower, the 16.3 Mini Prime sweep (4-0 with our side at 2 items online to their 4), our Fangtooth at 24.4 and their inner tower at 26.6 — majors 22-9 by the end. They won one fight all game and cashed nothing. The one sharpen: every early death was a solo catch outside any fight — Phase at 3.9, Steel at 4.5 and 6.6, Gadget at 17.7 — rotate in pairs and that team gets zero kills before the fights even start.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Conversion: six of eight fight wins became a major prize within 90 seconds — a 22-9 majors lead — while their only fight win bought nothing.

perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: GRIM.exe went 17/1/3 with 37441 hero damage and one death all game — and the team cashed the fights GRIM.exe carried: Mini Prime after 16.3, their inner tower at 26.6. This was the win condition; repeat it.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Phase 1/3/18 — textbook enabling. The one thing to cut is the 3.9 death: caught alone before any fight existed. Walk down with the carry and that death never happens.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Serath 8/3/3 — the 16.3 Mini Prime fight snowballed 4-0 with our side at 2 items online to their 4. One sharpen: at 21.8 Goldilocks324 was alive and never joined the fight the team lost 1-2 with a 5v4 man advantage.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Gadget traded a death in the 13.7 tower fight and the team still swept it 4-1 — that trade was fine. The one to cut is 17.7: caught alone between fights. Spend the damage inside the objective fights rather than solo on the map.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Steel finished 4/3/7 and anchored the 12.2 and 26.6 fight wins. Two of the three deaths were solo catches before minute 7 (4.5 and 6.6): on the frontliner, that early alone-time was the only thing feeding them.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Our damage is 4/5 magical — predictable; one magic-resist item answers most of it. Mix in a physical threat.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

enemyKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal

enemyKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult

grim-exe.loadout: Xyris (Iron Will + Bone Collector), augment System Restore, crest Eviscerator
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 1 time in 27 minutes, fewer deaths than about 95% of GRIM.exe carry players this patch. The build added healing off damage.
GRIM.exe dealt 37,441 hero damage, 37% of their team's, with +212 physical power from items.
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Scattershot (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Summon 2 projectiles from the Target. These home towards the closest Enemies. Each deals (+40%) Damage. Applies On-Hit effects at 50% effectiveness.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Eviscerator (crest): Gain 20% Attack Speed and 8% Omnivamp for 6s. Empower your Basic Attacks to deal (+10%) Damage On-Hit for 6s.
Xyris (Eternal): Deal 3% bonus damage, increased by 0.4% per 10 units killed, up to 400 units.
Iron Will (Eternal minor): Restore Health equal to 3% of Basic Attack damage dealt, increased to 6% for Critical Strikes.

Sustain: 22% lifesteal; Tainted Rounds: On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.; Terminus: On Overhealing from Lifesteal: Convert excess Healing into a Shield. Max Shield size: (+100%). The Shield slowly decays 15s after leaving combat.; 4,551 healing recorded.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 5 effects on one trigger: Lightning Hawk, Scattershot, Tainted Rounds, Eviscerator, Iron Will.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Tainted Rounds, Terminus, Eviscerator.
The Eternal was part of it: Xyris (Iron Will + Bone Collector) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 5 players GRIM.exe killed built physical armor (Grux). Anti-heal on Argus, Sparrow. We killed GRIM.exe 1 time.
Copy it? Xyris (Iron Will + Bone Collector): 54.8% in 146 GRIM.exe carry games, above the hero's 47.2%. Proven this patch: worth copying.
